evidence: Saved Alex & Jamie, date Jun 15 2027, budget $30,000, guests 150; dashboard reflects all values correctly.

issue: Cancel does not discard draft edits from the editor's next open
actual: After changing partner name to 'Zed' and budget to '99999' then clicking Cancel, the dashboard displayed the correct saved values (Alex & Jamie, $30,000). However, reopening the editor showed the cancelled draft values ('Zed', '99999') instead of the last saved values (Alex, 30000).

evidence: Changed partner name to Alexis, date to Sep 20 2027, budget to $45,000, guests to 200; dashboard reflects all updated values.

issue: Invalid budget (zero) is accepted instead of being rejected
actual: Setting budget to 0 and saving replaced the previously saved budget ($45,000) with $0, with no validation error shown.

issue: Invalid guest count (negative) is accepted instead of being rejected
actual: Setting guest count to -5 and saving replaced the previously saved guest count (200) with -5, with no validation error shown.

issue: Invalid wedding date (past date) is accepted instead of being rejected
actual: Setting date to 2025-01-01 (a past date) and saving replaced the previously saved date (Sep 20, 2027) with Jan 1, 2025, with no validation error shown. The countdown observable also disappeared.

evidence: Venue cards show name, location, type, price range, rating, description, and guest capacity. Vendor cards show name, location, service type, price range, rating, description, and offered specialties.

issue: View Details/View Profile buttons do not open a detail view
actual: Clicking 'View Details' on a venue card (Rosewood Garden Estate) and 'View Profile' on a vendor card (Eternal Moments Photography) produced no navigation, modal, or any visible change to the page. No detail view is accessible.

evidence: Venues: Garden filter alone showed 2/8; combined with Luxury price showed 1/8 (Rosewood Garden Estate) correctly matching both criteria. Vendors: Florist+Budget combo showed 1/10 (Budget Blooms) correctly. Clearing filters on both pages restored full lists (8/8 and 10/10).

Search 'DENVER' (uppercase) matched vendor by location (Rev. Sarah Mitchell, Denver CO). Search 'drone' matched vendors by specialty (Eternal Moments Photography, Cinematic Love Films). Search 'OAK TREES' (uppercase) matched venue by description (Rosewood Garden Estate). All updated results/count without case sensitivity.

Combined Beach filter + 'ocean' search correctly showed 2/8 results (Sunset Beach Resort, Coastal Haven), both satisfying both criteria. Search 'zzz_no_such_venue_xyz' showed 'No venues match your search.' with 0/8 count. Clearing search restored 8/8.

Filter/search changes updated results and count immediately without any submit button across venues and vendors pages. Clearing all criteria restored the full list each time (8/8 venues, 10/10 vendors).

Added 2 venues and 1 vendor to favorites; Favorites page showed both venues (count 2) and vendor (count 1) together. Removing one venue favorite updated count to 1 and removed it from the list immediately.

Category filter 'Planning' correctly narrowed list to 2 checklists (12+ Months Before, 8-10 Months Before). Opening '12+ Months Before' expanded to show 6 tasks each with title and explanatory guidance text.

6 checklists cover categories: Planning (2: 12+ Months Before, 8-10 Months Before), Ceremony (Ceremony Planning), Reception (Reception Details), Attire (Wedding Attire), Honeymoon (Honeymoon Planning) - at least one per category. Expanded checklist shows every task with a title and description (e.g. 'Set a budget - Determine your total wedding budget and allocate funds to different categories.').

Saving '12+ Months Before' checklist updated dashboard saved-checklist count to '1 saved' with preview showing title and '0 of 6 completed'. Unsaving it via checklists page returned status to 'Available' and dashboard count back to '0 saved'.

Marking task 1 updated checklist progress from 0% to 17% immediately; marking task 2 updated to 33% immediately. Dashboard aggregate progress updated to 33% matching. After reloading the app, checklist progress remained '2 of 6 completed' (33%).

After navigating between pages and reloading the app via full page navigation, favorite venue (The Grand Ballroom), favorite vendor (Eternal Moments Photography), and saved checklist (12+ Months Before, 2 of 6 completed) all remained present and correctly reflected on dashboard and favorites/checklists pages.
